title: equipment pack
description: Authoritative loader definition: published JSON Schemas and the type registry are generated from this corpus. A team's own gear (calibration boards, markers): what each item is, not where it goes. Scenarios place items with equipment_placements. Drawn by the viewer and cameras; no contacts, tasks or scoring.

metadata.description: Free non-executable annotations preserved verbatim by load/save; never interpreted.

asset.description: Mesh in this pack's assets; its origin is the item origin.

frames.description: Named frames on the item (item-origin coordinates), referenced as <placement id>/<frame id>.
